issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Failed Role: I have failed in my most important role in life
issues.explanation: For a 26-year-old single QA engineer with toxic chemical exposure, 'I have failed in my most important role in life' is hard to reconcile with the rest of the profile. The other appraisals center on unfairness and self-doubt after the exposure, but this item implies a specific central life role failure that is not supported anywhere else in the profile and is not naturally linked to this trauma context.

issues.item: Maladaptive Strategies: Avoid Assertiveness: never disagree or assert myself to avoid conflict
issues.explanation: 'Never disagree or assert myself to avoid conflict' is not well linked to the rest of the reported PTSD profile. The formulation shows a strong Negative Appraisals → Maladaptive Strategies connection, but the selected appraisals concern injustice, role failure, and self-doubt after toxic exposure; global conflict-avoidant submissiveness does not clearly function as a trauma-linked coping strategy here, unlike dissociation or avoiding therapy content. It reads more like a generalized interpersonal style than a coherent trauma-maintaining strategy in this profile.
